def safe_divide(a, b)
  return nil unless a.is_a?(Numeric) && b.is_a?(Numeric)
  
  begin
    result = a / b
    return result
  rescue ZeroDivisionError => e
    puts "Warning: #{e.message}"
    return nil
  rescue TypeError => e
    puts "Warning: #{e.message}"
    return nil
  end
end
